title: 第23章 炼器学徒第24章 提纯融合制胚
lines: 次日，李卓阳收拾一番，便早早来到了炼器坊。
“咦，居然又是你？”昨日那位师姐见到李卓阳再次到来，很是吃惊。
“昨日你没被周长老赶走吗？”她诧异地问道。
“自然没有，周长老虽待人严苛了一些，但是有真才实学的，在下自然要好好珍惜。”
说完，他不顾那女弟子的惊异目光，朝内殿走去。
那周长老却是早已经倚靠在躺椅上，半眯着眼睛，也不知他是没走，还是早就来到了。
“见过师祖。”李卓阳上前行礼道。
“嗯，来得挺早，接着！”
说着他将一个储物袋扔给了李卓阳。
“昨日你走得匆忙，我这当师祖的竟然忘记给你见面礼了，这些小玩意儿你就收着吧。”
李卓阳将神识探入一看，大为吃惊。
原来里面居然放着十几件法器，看样子，每件都是上品甚至极品法器，除此之外，还有几块玉简和玉瓶。
“财不外露，知道吗？等你回去了慢慢查看，今日先开始学习炼器。”
李卓阳躬身答应。
“炼器，分为选材、提炼、融合、制胚、刻阵这五个步骤……”
周长老躺着，向李卓阳开始讲解炼器的基础知识，这些内容，虽然李卓阳可以通过阅读典藏得知，但是与名师亲自传授相比，效果不可同日而语。
这番讲述，讲者孜孜不倦，听者津津有味，不知不觉，一上午就过去了。
周长老已经辟谷，要就不用吃饭了，可李卓阳肚子却咕噜噜叫了起来。
“这瓶辟谷丹你拿着吧，时间紧迫，以后到我这里学习时，就不要进食了。”
周长老说着将一个玉瓶抛给李卓阳。
李卓阳接过后，赶紧服用一颗，这一颗足以让他一日一夜不用进食。
接着二人又是一番传授，直至周长老露出疲态，才终于停止了传授。
而李卓阳对炼器的基本常识，已经了解的差不多了。
“你的领悟能力不错，不过学的再多，终究不如实际操作一次，今日你的任务就是将那堆灵矿，按照纯度高低依次分为十份，检验一下你在选材方面的天赋到底如何。”
“好的，师祖。”李卓阳满口答应。
“你挑选完后，就可以直接回去了，老夫有事先行离开。”
说完，他也不等李卓阳的回应，便起身离去。
不知为何，周长老起身的一刻，李卓阳竟感觉他的身上笼罩着一层灰色光晕。
不过来不及多想，李卓阳就立即投入到矿石的挑选中去了。
四百多块灵矿，即便有玄天宝鉴的帮助，也会耗费不少时间的。
忙碌的时间过得很快，等李卓阳将所有灵矿都按照纯度高低排列好之后，外面已经明月高悬了。
而李卓阳也感觉脑袋有些发胀，他知道这是神识操控玄天宝鉴时间过长导致的。
回到杂货铺，李卓阳立即开始了吸纳灵石的修炼，在吸纳的间隙，还不停地饮用龙江灵茶。
只是灵石补充灵气，灵茶缓解肉身，他的神识却得不到快速的恢复。
这时李卓阳忽然想起了师祖赐予的见面礼，连忙将储物袋打开。
content_en:
The next day, Li Zhuoyang packed up and came to the weapon refining workshop early.
"Hey, it's you again?" The senior sister yesterday was very surprised when she saw Li Zhuoyang coming again.
"Weren't you driven away by Elder Zhou yesterday?" she asked in surprise.
"Of course not. Although Elder Zhou is a bit harsh on others, I should cherish those who are truly talented and learned."
After saying that, he ignored the surprised look of the female disciple and walked towards the inner hall.
Elder Zhou was already leaning on the recliner with his eyes half-squinted. It was unclear whether he had not left or had arrived a long time ago.
"I've met Master." Li Zhuoyang stepped forward and saluted.
"Well, you're here quite early, let's go on!"
As he spoke, he threw a storage bag to Li Zhuoyang.
"You left in a hurry yesterday, and I, the master, forgot to give you a meeting gift. Just keep these gadgets."
Li Zhuoyang looked into it with his spiritual consciousness and was greatly surprised.
It turned out that there were more than a dozen magical artifacts inside, and it seemed that each one was a top-grade or even top-quality magical artifact. In addition, there were several jade slips and jade bottles.
"Don't expose your wealth to anyone, you know? Wait until you go back and check it out slowly, and start learning to refine weapons today."
Li Zhuoyang bowed and agreed.
"Tool refining is divided into five steps: material selection, refining, fusion, embryo making, and formation engraving..."
Elder Zhou lay down and began to explain the basic knowledge of weapon refining to Li Zhuoyang. Although Li Zhuoyang could learn these contents by reading the collection, the effect was not the same as teaching it in person by a famous master.
The speaker worked tirelessly and the listeners enjoyed this narration, and before they knew it, the whole morning passed.
Elder Zhou had already abstained from eating grains, otherwise he didn't need to eat, but Li Zhuoyang's stomach growled.
"Take this bottle of Bigu Pill. Time is tight. When you come to study with me in the future, don't eat."
Elder Zhou said and threw a jade bottle to Li Zhuoyang.
After Li Zhuoyang took it, he quickly took one pill. This pill was enough to keep him from eating for a whole day and night.
Then the two of them taught again, until Elder Zhou showed signs of fatigue and finally stopped teaching.
Li Zhuoyang already has a basic understanding of the basic knowledge of weapon refining.
"Your comprehension ability is good, but no matter how much you learn, it is better to actually operate it once. Today your task is to divide the pile of spiritual minerals into ten parts according to their purity to test your talent in material selection."
"Okay, Master." Li Zhuoyang agreed.
"After you finish selecting, you can go back directly. I have to leave first."
After saying that, he stood up and left without waiting for Li Zhuoyang's response.
For some reason, the moment Elder Zhou stood up, Li Zhuoyang felt a gray halo covering his body.
But before he had time to think about it, Li Zhuoyang immediately threw himself into selecting the ore.
There are more than four hundred pieces of spiritual minerals. Even with the help of Xuantian Baojian, it will take a lot of time.
The busy time passed quickly. After Li Zhuoyang arranged all the spiritual minerals according to their purity, the bright moon was already hanging high outside.
Li Zhuoyang also felt that his head was a little swollen. He knew that this was caused by his spiritual consciousness controlling Xuantian Baojian for too long.
Back at the grocery store, Li Zhuoyang immediately began to practice absorbing spirit stones. During the period of absorbing, he kept drinking Longjiang spirit tea.
It was just that the spiritual stone replenished spiritual energy and the spiritual tea soothed the physical body, but his consciousness could not recover quickly.
At this time, Li Zhuoyang suddenly remembered the meeting gift given by his master and quickly opened the storage bag.
title_en: Chapter 23: Weapon Refining Apprentice Chapter 24: Purification, Fusion and Embryo Making
